question: Which powers are included among the nine powers named here?
premises: There are nine powers in total.
Suprabha and Vijaya are named among them.
One of them is described as giving all success.
inference: The nine powers include Suprabha, Vijaya, and one who grants all success.
uncertainties: The full list of nine powers is not completely enumerated in this verse alone.
plain_english: Suprabha, Vijaya, the giver of all success—these are among the nine powers.
